description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。
description.en: A client token. It ensures the idempotence of the request and prevents the same request from being submitted multiple times.
The ID of the restore job.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dbs start-restore-task --restore-task-id s102h7rfXXXX --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxx --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dbs StartRestoreTask --region cn-hangzhou --RestoreTaskId s102h7rfXXXX --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxx
